name: UTM Guest Auto-Connect
description: Works with exactly one site: the UTM-WiNetUni_GUEST campus portal at https://sb.sdn.utm.md:19008/portalpage/. When Firefox reports the network as captive, this extension loads that portal page in a background tab, ticks the 'Acceptarea Termenilor și Condițiilor' checkbox and presses 'Conectare' — the same two clicks you would make — then closes the tab again. It repeats automatically when the 2-hour session drops. Clicking the toolbar icon switches the automatic behaviour on/off (grey icon = off, green = connected, red = waiting for the portal, blue = trying). Traffic goes only to that portal and to Firefox's own captive-portal check hosts (detectportal.firefox.com, captive.apple.com). Nothing is collected, stored or transmitted about you; no credentials are involved because the portal logs every guest in anonymously.
